# Source Readback Delta

The Awtsmoos hides depth until it is needed; Awtsmoos.com now begins mobile Social Hub with one clear action and retracts everything secondary.

## Final mobile hierarchy
- Top identity/context is one compact native details row, closed by default.
- Home shows exactly one Create action; the floating creator is hidden on Home.
- On non-Home routes the compact persistent Create remains fixed above the dock.
- Public Discovery appears before pulse, actions, and advanced capability tools.
- Profile lookup is closed by default.
- Pulse metrics are behind `Your pulse`.
- Question, Heichel, review, and comment actions are behind `More actions`.
- `Everything social` is demoted below primary content and remains closed by default.

## Phone geometry
At 390px: header 64px, Create 54px, zero horizontal overflow, one visible Create, all disclosures closed, advanced capability after actions, dock entirely inside the viewport.

At 320px: header 52px, Create 54px, zero horizontal overflow, one visible Create, all disclosures closed, advanced capability after actions, dock entirely inside the viewport, and zero browser harness errors.

A combined two-width harness once failed during the second app boot while still showing the static fallback shell. A clean isolated 320px run then booted normally and passed every geometry assertion, proving the earlier event was a harness startup race rather than a product-width defect.

The Awtsmoos remains one when complexity is folded away; Awtsmoos.com now reveals depth only when the user chooses it.
